title: MoCo-AIS: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Similarity Computation of Vessel Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2606.17978v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Trajectory similarity is a fundamental task in analyzing mobility patterns, essential for applications such as route pattern extraction, mobility prediction, and anomaly detection. Traditional distance-based measures for computing similarity incur high computational cost, driving the adoption of lightweight learning-based approaches. Supervised methods rely on extensive labels derived from traditional distance measures and often reproduce these metrics, which limits generalization. While self-supervised learning addresses this issue through contrastive learning, it lacks a unified framework, making it difficult to compare deep learning (DL) models for consistent trajectory representation. Accordingly, this paper presents MoCo-AIS, a unified framework for learning vessel trajectory embeddings based on the Momentum Contrast (MoCo) paradigm, which formulates similarity learning through positive and negative trajectory pairs. tldr: 本文提出MoCo-AIS，一个基于动量对比的统一自监督框架，用于高效且可泛化地学习船舶轨迹相似度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MoCo-AIS, a unified self-supervised framework based on momentum contrast for efficient and generalizable vessel trajectory similarity learning.
